name: use-size
title: Use Size
description: Measures an element with ResizeObserver and returns its content width and height in whole pixels.

meta.when: Drawing to the size of a container: charts, canvases. For layout that only needs to adapt, use container queries (`@container`, `@md:`) instead.
meta.example:
const { ref, width, height } = useSize(); return
{width > 0 && }
;
